verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Isaac ships agent skills for development tasks such as installation, environment creation, RL training, and ROS node upgrades. It also offers ROS packages and policy deployment bundles for real hardware. None of this documents an AI agent authenticating with scoped credentials or commanding a physical robot end-to-end through a platform API or SDK; these are adjacent building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an AI agent authenticate with scoped credentials and command a real robot end-to-end through the platform's API or SDK
